scoring_justification: Agent's raw CSV artifacts are compared pointwise to paper-reported values with tolerances; phonon softening trend and monotonic lattice increase are verified.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference lattice constants, phonon frequencies, and heat capacity values from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: lattice constants from Fig.1 and Vegard law; phonon frequencies ~350 cm⁻¹ (Mg2Si) and ~200 cm⁻¹ (Mg2Sn) from phonon softening discussion; heat capacity at 300 K (50.0 J/mol·K) and 1000 K (74.8 J/mol·K) from Fig.4(c) and Dulong-Petit limit.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are exactly the paper's reported quantities for the same conditions; used for tolerance-based verification of the agent's reproduction.

outputs.description: Equilibrium lattice constants for six Sn concentrations. The hidden checker will compare each submitted lattice constant to a hidden reference value within a tolerance and verify that the lattice constant increases monotonically with x.

Highest optical phonon frequency at the Gamma point for x=0 and x=1. The hidden checker will verify that the frequency for Mg2Si is greater than for Mg2Sn (trend) and compare absolute values to hidden reference values within tolerance.
Constant-volume heat capacity of Mg2Si as a function of temperature. The hidden checker will compare C_v at 300 K and 1000 K to hidden reference values within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The task focuses on the lattice constant trend (Vegard's law), the phonon softening between pure Mg2Si and Mg2Sn, and the harmonic heat capacity of Mg2Si. Elastic constants and full phonon dispersion curves are not required.
